text:
Maya: opened PR #4333 to add migration guidance for Private installer when customers consolidate to single-NIC (dual->single) on bare-metal. Touches networking, KMS/HSM mgmt ports, and the install-playbook. Coordinating examples + link fixes.

Ashley: thanks. Can you summarize the customer repros so we can make the troubleshooting concise?

Maya: summary: some installs have an aggressive NAT rule (cloud-init/SDN) that matches all outgoing on the default iface. HSM agents binding to a bridge (br0) see mgmt traffic (ports 8700/8743) SNAT'd; vendor console loses reachability. Also saw OVS hairpin + SR-IOV VLAN tagging change source IPs.

Sam: let's include iptables-save + nftables equiv and the minimal accept-before-snat example, e.g.:
```bash
# accept mgmt ports before broad SNAT
iptables -t nat -A POSTROUTING -p tcp --dport 8700:8743 -j ACCEPT
# scoped SNAT instead of global
iptables -t nat -A POSTROUTING -o eth0 -s 10.0.0.0/24 -j SNAT --to-source $PUBLIC_IP
```

Priya: nftables example (explicit and interface-aware):
```bash
nft add rule ip nat postrouting oifname "eth0" tcp dport {8700,8743} accept
```
Also documented an OVS connmark flow to tag br0-origin traffic and exempt it from NAT.

Ashley: style nit: render ports as code (e.g., `8700`) and add a short Migration FAQ: "Will this affect TLS certs?" (answer: no, but IP changes affect audit mappings).

Maya: added Migration FAQ + cert note. Fixed a broken crosslink from install-playbook -> private/kms that linkcheck flagged.

docs-bot: Linkcheck: stale anchor in private/install-playbook -> 'hsm-management' detected. Update before merge. :robot_face:

Maya: pushed commit 3 with anchor update, nftables/iptables snippets, and an OVS connmark example. PR: https://redwood.internal/docs/pr/4333

Sam: quick review requests: make iptables rules idempotent (check -C then -A) and include a one-liner to detect existing SNAT (iptables -t nat -L POSTROUTING -n --line-numbers | grep SNAT). Then i can approve.

Priya: added SR-IOV guidance: if VF MACs migrate, prefer MAC pinning or host-network mode for HSM containers.

Ashley: LGTM. suggestion: collapse OVS example to keep quickstart lean.

Maya: done. will squash & merge when lint + linkcheck are green. ping me for a v1.2 backport after merge.

Sam: thanks, i'll watch CI.
